_comment: INVENTED test records for local development only. No real company, posting or application. Turned into test/seed.sql by tools/to-sql.mjs.

postings.title: Simulation Engineer (heat transfer)
postings.eligibility_quote_de: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Physik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachs
postings.eligibility_en: Degree in physics, mechanical engineering or comparable.
postings.note: Invented test card: finite-volume models of heat exchangers; physics named, no years of experience demanded.
postings.note_de: Erfundene Testkarte: Finite-Volumen-Modelle von Wärmetauschern; Physik ist genannt, Berufserfahrung wird nicht verlangt.

postings.title: Data Analyst (energy markets)
postings.eligibility_quote_de: Studium der Mathematik, Physik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften
postings.eligibility_en: Degree in mathematics, physics, statistics or economics.
postings.note: Invented test card. This note is long on purpose, so that the card shows the More button: it runs past one hundred and sixty characters and is clamped to three lines until the card is opened.

postings.title: Test Engineer, Calibration Lab
postings.eligibility_quote_de: Bachelor in Physik, Elektrotechnik oder Messtechnik
postings.eligibility_en: Bachelor in physics, electrical engineering or metrology.
postings.note: Invented test card: calibration of pressure sensors.

postings.title: Junior Physicist, Optics
postings.eligibility_quote_de: BSc or MSc in Physics or Applied Physics
postings.note: Invented test card on the Europe board.

postings.title: Production Shift Supervisor
postings.eligibility_en: Degree in natural sciences or engineering.
postings.note: Invented test card, already marked as applied in the test marks.

postings.title: Removed test card
postings.note: Invented: removed from the list, must not show.

meta.rule: Every posting names physics or natural sciences as an accepted degree, accepts a Bachelor, is not student or PhD, and links to the employer's own page.
meta.rule_eu: Europe outside Germany. Every posting names physics or natural sciences as an accepted degree and is at an employer that hires internationals.

applicationLog.note: Invented: an application to a posting that was never on the list.
